definitions.explanation: Pizza, transcribed closer to the Italian pronunciation than the usual ピザ. Chosen by authentic Italian restaurants and wood-fired-oven shops to signal that the pizza is Neapolitan rather than American-style.

examples.japanese: ピッツァ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薪|まき}{窯|がま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ピッツァ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いている→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant bakes its pizzas in a wood-fired oven.

examples.japanese: ナポリ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{修業|しゅぎょう}→修業：16906_shugyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ピッツァ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ふち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ふっくら→ふっくら：28254_fukkura⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The pizza baked by a craftsman who trained in Naples has a plump, puffy crust edge.

notes:
Counted with 〜⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧. A register variant rather than a different food: in ordinary conversation people say ⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧, and ピッツァ appears mainly on Italian restaurant menus and in food writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピッツァ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to bake a pizza
- ⟦{窯|かま}→窯：13764_kama⟧{焼|や}きピッツァ: oven-baked (wood-fired) pizza
- ピッツァ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧: a pizza craftsman, pizzaiolo
- ナポリピッツァ: Neapolitan pizza

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧: pizza — the ordinary everyday word, used for delivery and chain-store pizza
- ⟦マルゲリータ→マルゲリータ：30403_marugeriita⟧: margherita — the classic tomato-and-mozzarella pizza
- ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧: dough — the word used for the base in pizza talk
